title_zh: 调整了导航、首页、界面样式
message: Clarify navigation state and compact home intro
story_zh: 页面还可以更清楚、更顺手。这次重新整理了导航、首页、界面样式的视觉与交互。
story_en: The site could feel clearer and easier to use, so I refined the visual design and interaction of navigation, Home, interface styling.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Clarify navigation state and compact home intro
details_zh: 调整首页介绍、研究兴趣或全球要闻卡片。优化页面的排版、间距与响应式视觉效果。调整页面组件与内容结构。
details_en: Refined the home introduction, research interests, or global-news card. Improved typography, spacing, and responsive visual presentation. Adjusted page components and content structure.

title_zh: 调整了页面结构、网站日志、界面样式
title_en: Refined page structure, Site Log, interface styling
message: Rebalance home and group site log by date
story_zh: 页面还可以更清楚、更顺手。这次重新整理了页面结构、网站日志、界面样式的视觉与交互。
story_en: The site could feel clearer and easier to use, so I refined the visual design and interaction of page structure, Site Log, interface styling.
purpose_zh: 持续改进网站内容、信息组织与使用体验。
purpose_en: Rebalance home and group site log by date
details_zh: 调整网站日志的归档内容、呈现方式或自动记录。优化页面的排版、间距与响应式视觉效果。调整页面组件与内容结构。
details_en: Refined the site-log archive, presentation, or automatic record. Improved typography, spacing, and responsive visual presentation. Adjusted page components and content structure.

story_zh: 首页的信息有些挤。我重新安排了正文宽度和新闻卡片，让介绍、新闻与研究兴趣各自拥有清楚的节奏。
story_en: The home page felt crowded, so I rebalanced its text width and news cards to give each section a clearer rhythm.

title_zh: 首页只留下需要的内容
story_zh: 首页不必像一份完整简历。我移除了重复的教育板块，让个人介绍和研究兴趣成为真正的主角。
story_en: The home page does not need to read like a full CV. I removed the repeated education section so the introduction and research interests could lead.
message: Remove Education section from home pages

title_zh: 把世界装进一个小窗口
title_en: A small window onto the world
story_zh: 为了更好地了解世界上发生了什么，我加入了每日新闻：每小时更新，并把简讯按日期安静地保存下来。
story_en: To keep a closer eye on the world, I added Daily News: an hourly briefing with a date-by-date archive.
message: Add automated daily global news briefing

title_zh: 论文可以按年份寻找了
story_zh: 成果渐渐多起来后，逐张翻找并不轻松。我加入了年份筛选，让不同阶段的论文更快被找到。
story_en: As the publication list grew, browsing every card became slow. A year filter now makes each period easier to find.
message: Add year filter to publications pages

story_zh: 学习札记的三张卡片现在可以展开；网站日志的每条记录也有了直达修改入口。需要操作的地方终于会给出回应。
story_en: The three Study Notes cards can now expand, and every site-log entry has a direct edit route. Interactive areas finally respond as expected.
message: Add per-entry edit links to site log and expandable study-note cards

story_zh: 我重新整理了首页文字，用更直接的方式说明自己的身份、研究兴趣，以及这个网站准备记录什么。
story_en: I rewrote the home introduction to state more directly who I am, what I study, and what this website will hold.

title_zh: 网站开始记住自己的变化
story_zh: 我加入了双语网站日志，也整理了学习札记。页面不只展示结果，也开始保存它一步步长成的过程。
story_en: I added a bilingual Site Log and refined Study Notes, allowing the website to preserve how it grows rather than only showing the result.
message: Add bilingual site log and refine notes

title_en: Even small changes leave a trace
story_zh: 为了不遗漏日常调整，我让网站日志能够读取更新记录，并把内容页的宽度、留白和圆角重新对齐。
story_en: To keep everyday refinements from disappearing, I connected the log to site updates and aligned the width, spacing, and corners of content pages.
message: Align content pages and automate site log

title_zh: 导航和内容有了新的秩序
title_en: A new order for navigation and content
story_zh: 原来的导航和内容分布不够清楚。我重新安排了间距，加入卡片式设计，也让期刊标签更醒目。
story_en: The navigation and content distribution lacked clarity, so I reworked the spacing, introduced cards, and made publication badges easier to notice.
message: Refine homepage layout, language switch, and publication badges

title_zh: 语言按钮真正动了起来
story_zh: 中英文切换曾经更像一枚静态按钮。我把它改成可操作的分段开关，并让每个页面都通往对应译文。
story_en: The language control once looked more active than it was. I turned it into a true segmented switch and paired every page with its translation.

title_zh: 手机端不再需要左右寻找
title_en: No more sideways searching on mobile
story_zh: 手机端曾出现横向滚动，语言开关也跑到屏幕外。我重新排列了导航、人物卡片和正文，让内容回到一列之中。
story_en: Mobile pages once scrolled sideways and pushed the language switch off-screen. I rebuilt the navigation, profile card, and content into one clean column.
message: Fix mobile home layout and navigation

title_zh: 为学习札记留出三扇门
story_zh: 我建立了研究方法、智能传播和全球传播三个栏目，也预留了上传文件与添加链接的入口。
story_en: I created three spaces for Research Methods, Intelligent Communication, and Global Communication, with routes for files and links.
message: Refine publications and add study note hub

title_zh: 论文卡片更适合阅读了
title_en: Publication cards become easier to read
story_zh: 论文信息被重新压缩和分组：每行两张卡片，标题更克制，分区标签固定在容易看到的位置。
story_en: Publication information was regrouped into two compact cards per row, with quieter titles and consistently placed ranking badges.

title_zh: 人物面板终于看得清了
title_en: A profile panel with clearer contrast
story_zh: 深色人物面板曾让文字和图标显得含混。我提升了对比度，并为论文卡片换上更协调的自然风景。
story_en: Text and icons once faded into the dark profile panel. I improved the contrast and paired publication cards with calmer landscape imagery.
message: Improve profile contrast and publication covers

story_zh: 创建了本网站。初版设计包括中英双语首页、个人信息面板、论文发表、学习札记，以及一套黑白灰的视觉系统。
story_en: I created this website. Its first edition included bilingual home pages, a profile panel, Publications, Study Notes, and a black-white-gray visual system.
